subject: Milestone Agreement & Eval Plan for Aurelia POC
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Mitchell <sandra@aureliasystems.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-03-01T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Milestone Agreement & Eval Plan for Aurelia POC

Hi Sandra —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a lightweight Milestone Agreement (MAP) template I use to keep POCs on track. I filled the first pass with what we discussed and a suggested 6-week timeline. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm primary stakeholders (technical + procurement) so we can lock reviewers?
- Can you add success metrics to the "Acceptance" column (e.g., latency targets, cost per inference, sample prompts)?
- Is the proposed go/no-go date of 2026-04-15 reasonable for Aurelia?

I've also started a short 3-slide executive summary deck (stub attached) that we can share with your leadership — one slide for goals/methodology, one for milestones, one for risks & mitigations. If you prefer, we can turn the MAP into a shared Google Doc and work live.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm stakeholders and acceptance metrics by Tue 3/2
2) We update MAP and share exec deck by Wed 3/3
3) 30-min alignment call for sign-off the week of 3/8

I attached: MAP_Milestone_Template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) and Aurelia_POC_Exec_Summary_Slides_v1.pptx (deck stub).

Link to editable MAP (draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cAurelia-MAP-Draft

Happy to adjust timelines — what matters most is that you have the right stakeholders in the loop.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Sandra Mitchell <sandra@aureliasystems.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@aureliasystems.com
Date: 2026-03-01T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Milestone Agreement & Eval Plan for Aurelia POC

Laura —

Appreciate this, the template looks good and the timeline is close to what we had in mind. A few quick notes:

- Procurement (cc'd) needs the commercial milestones moved slightly earlier to fit our internal approval windows; can we shift contract-sign by 3 business days?
- Technical owners: Myself (SRE) and Marco Li (ML Lead). I can add Marco to the doc once you share the editable link.
- Acceptance criteria: I added a note — primary acceptance will be throughput at 99th percentile < 300ms and sample prompt pass-rate > 95%. We may adjust after first week of runs.

Also — can you provide a one-page executive summary (PDF or slides) suitable for our VP of Product? A short bulleted risk section would be great.

Let's tentatively schedule the alignment call on 2026-03-10 at 10:00 PT; procurement will confirm availability.

Thanks,
Sandra Mitchell
SRE Manager | Aurelia Systems
sandra@aureliasystems.com

Jonas: can you update the MAP doc with the acceptance metrics Sandra added and shift the commercial milestone earlier by 3 business days (as procurement requested)? I've attached the current spreadsheet for reference.

I'll coordinate scheduling once we have the updated doc. Sandra — adding Marco will be helpful; please add him to the Google Doc or let me know his email and I'll invite.

Thanks — Laura
